base.description: Factual, computational, and interpretive correctness; uncertainty is preserved.
Uses enough appropriate evidence, records provenance, and does not upgrade weak proxies into proof.
Covers the material work implied by the contract and requested detail level without filler.
A competent professional could use the result without rebuilding the work from scratch.
The work is tied to the actual business objective rather than vanity activity.
The work includes the reasonable research, strategy, execution, QA, and integration needed to maximize the intended result.
AURA state, provenance, lifecycle, ownership, completion, and receipts accurately reflect what happened.

profile_descriptions.live_serp_or_answer_environment: Inspects the current search/AI-answer field rather than relying only on model memory.
profile_descriptions.leader_comparison: Compares multiple leaders and identifies both common expected patterns and meaningful differences among #1/#2/#3 or analogous leaders.
profile_descriptions.competitive_search_readiness: Finished work plausibly competes for the intended search/answer outcome, acknowledging authority or external constraints content alone cannot solve.
profile_descriptions.ad_library_or_market_sampling: Samples multiple relevant active/persistent/top-performing creatives or competitors using available transparency/creative centers and surrounding funnel evidence.
profile_descriptions.proxy_calibration: Treats longevity, views, shares, engagement, repeated creative families, and platform metrics as evidence of differing strength—not direct proof of profit unless first-party data exists.
profile_descriptions.baseline_normalization: Normalizes visible content performance against creator/account baseline, age, format, audience size, and distribution where possible.
profile_descriptions.mechanism_extraction: Extracts transferable mechanisms rather than copying protected expression, branding, or exact creative.
profile_descriptions.appropriate_detail: Uses the level of detail the audience and communication task require; more detail is not automatically better.
profile_descriptions.artifact_usability: Produces the actual promised artifact in an immediately usable form rather than a description of what could be produced.
profile_descriptions.cross_domain_coordination: Uses the right semantic owners and handoffs across domains instead of duplicating the same problem or research in multiple systems.
profile_descriptions.state_compounding: Later work becomes better informed by accumulated AURA state instead of repeatedly starting from scratch.
profile_descriptions.contradiction_handling: Later contradictory evidence revises confidence, hypotheses, or Learning rather than being ignored to preserve a convenient narrative.
profile_descriptions.concurrent_state_integrity: Shared workspace remains valid and reconstructable while multiple operators act at the same time.
profile_descriptions.deduplication: Overlapping evidence, Insights, Opportunities, and Assets are resolved/reused rather than multiplied into competing canonical copies.
profile_descriptions.operator_provenance: Concurrent work remains attributable to the correct operator/run without collapsing identity or authority.
